text:
Predicates:
Contain(x, y) ::: x contains tons of knowledge.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads book y.
Gains(x, y) ::: x gains knowledge from y.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → Contain(x, knowledge)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y (Person(x) ∧ Reads(x, y) → Gains(x, knowledge)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (Gains(x, knowledge) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
Smarter(harry) ::: Harry is smarter than before.
